_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 66: 22-28 May 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says that when he saw him it was something to do with Church of His Presence, that he will be invited there maybe in September during this feast date from Rosh Hashanah, that he does not know but could see him there, and that he does not know why he was seeing it.
mentions.quote: he'll be invited there maybe in September during this feast date
mentions.falsify_match: A named minister speaking at that named church in September 2026, which would be publicly advertised.
mentions.falsify_miss: He does not appear. Unusually checkable, though he says twice that he does not know why he is seeing it.

mentions.claim_text: He says he can solve the riddle or the clue but has to pray it out and that it takes time and effort, that you sit at his feet, and that sometimes he will not bring that up again for a long time and will show him something else instead.
mentions.quote: I have to pray this out and it takes time. It takes effort
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it explains why so many images in this corpus are never resolved: the subject changes before they are.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he is going to be the one who helps lead the charge when it is over, and that he slays his thousands while the other one slays more.
mentions.quote: He's the one that helps lead the charge when it's over
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the Saul and David idiom again, with nobody named.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether they got anything out of it tonight and says it was different, prays over their nation and over Cuba, gives thanks for Cuba, says Cuba will be liberated, and prays over Brazil.
mentions.quote: Cuba will be liberated
mentions.falsify_match: Regime change in Cuba.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The 2027 date from January has now dropped away entirely.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord is saying this would be the far left concerning Australia, that digital IDs are coming, and that he would even say this is going to be put out this year to start coming into 2027 when they will really try to implement it.
mentions.quote: Digital IDs is coming. put out this year to start coming into 2027
mentions.falsify_match: Australian digital identity legislation being implemented in that window.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is not. A named country, a named policy and a two year window, which is more specific than most.

mentions.claim_text: He says the First Amendment will be challenged greatly in 2028 and their First Amendment rights will be challenged greatly, and that he saw a web wrapped around by a spider all the way across, with the spider having built a web all around it.
mentions.quote: the First Amendment will be challenged greatly in 2028
mentions.falsify_match: Major legal challenges to speech protections in 2028.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Challenged greatly has no threshold, but the year is fixed.

mentions.claim_text: He prays for people running for office who will rise up and talk about Jesus, says they may not have any experience but asks God to anoint them to do it, and names Mike Lindells and Brians and people over Oklahoma and these areas.
mentions.quote: They may not have any experience, Lord, but anoint them to do it
mentions.falsify_match: Inexperienced religious candidates winning office.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not run or do not win. Lack of experience is treated as no obstacle, which is worth recording.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees Jonathan Cahn very clearly and asks what about Jonathan, that he sees the Harbingers, asks what he is saying, says he sees him going to Church of His Presence, that he sees John Kilpatrick, and asks whether he is going there in September.
mentions.quote: I see Jonathan Cahn very clear. Is he going there in September?
mentions.falsify_match: Named ministers appearing at that named church in September, which is publicly advertised.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not. Three living people named, which makes this among the most checkable claims in the corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees it in the two years, repeats that he sees two years, and names 2027 and 2028.
mentions.quote: I see two years 2027 2028
mentions.falsify_match: Whatever is meant occurring across those two years.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The window is stated and the content is not.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees the harbingers coming, that there is something, a moed, which is the appointed time, that it is with the harbinger and the appointed times, and that he sees this two year window going into it.
mentions.quote: It's the appointed time. It's with the harbinger and the appointed times
mentions.falsify_match: Appointed times falling in that window.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Moed is the Hebrew word for a feast or appointed time, and every year contains them.

mentions.claim_text: He says he hears the word moed again, asks whether he is saying it right, works through the pronunciation several times, settles on the appointed times, and says he believes Sister Billy uses this word.
mentions.quote: I hear the word Moed again. Am I saying that right?
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and worth recording: he attributes the term to another teacher he has heard use it.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says that when he had the visitation and saw heaven about a month or two ago, Brother Hagin said the revival will last for two years and asked what he will do with the timeframe, and repeats the question about the appointed times.
mentions.quote: Brother Hagin said, The revival will last for two years
mentions.falsify_match: A revival beginning and lasting two years.
mentions.falsify_miss: None begins. The word comes from a dead minister in a vision, which puts it beyond any check but his own account.

mentions.claim_text: He says the harbingers and the moeds are coming to an end and this is the timeframe, tells them to watch, and says he does not know whether Cahn will write another book but there is something to do with Church of His Presence and whether he will preach there.
mentions.quote: the harbingers, the Moeds, they're coming to an end
mentions.falsify_match: A further book from the named author, or an appearance at that church.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. Both are publicly checkable.

mentions.claim_text: He says he told them the attack would concern Soleimani as revenge over the drone strike against him, that he saw retaliation coming against the president's children and especially Don Jr, and that he prays over them every single time.
mentions.quote: I saw retaliation coming against his children and especially Don Jr
mentions.falsify_match: An attempt against a member of the president's family traced to Iranian retaliation. The video title reports exactly such a plot.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such plot. Both his earlier tellings and the reported plot are checkable, which makes this one of the stronger fulfilment claims in the corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He says he might butcher the name because he is not good with names, is helped with it, asks whether they see the accuracy, and says they are praying for his kids and for Don Jr whose wedding is next week or this week.
mentions.quote: so do you see accuracy
mentions.falsify_match: The accuracy claim put directly to the audience, with the earlier tellings available to check.
mentions.falsify_miss: The earlier tellings do not name the family.

mentions.claim_text: He says what the devil meant for bad God turns around for good if you believe him for it, that he believes they will see some good days ahead for the body of Christ, asks what they found and tells them to play it, and dates the word to April 6th.
mentions.quote: This is April 6th. April 6th, this word came
mentions.falsify_match: Eleventh on-air replay of an original recording, and 6 April is inside this corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: The clip does not say what he says it says.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees a surprise attack, repeats it, says it is one where they have infiltrated within, repeats that they have infiltrated within, and that he told them it would be worse than October.
mentions.quote: I see a surprise attack where they have infiltrated within
mentions.falsify_match: An attack carried out by people already inside the country.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Eighth telling of the worse-than-October claim, now relocated from Israel to the United States.

mentions.claim_text: He says the mountain was glowing in the dark and was glowing, that he knows that is a metaphor and does not think it is really glowing with green light, and that he saw Israel about to use tech with some kind of device that has never been used before.
mentions.quote: Israel about to use a device that has never been used before
mentions.falsify_match: Israel deploying a novel weapon system.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He marks the glowing mountain as metaphor himself, which is the right instinct and is worth recording.

mentions.claim_text: He says he put it in the picture at the beginning of the year, and reads that NASA says they are going to build the new moon base with a live news event on Tuesday May 26th to share updates on their lunar exploration plans.
mentions.quote: NASA says they're going to build the new moon base
mentions.falsify_match: A real dated announcement offered as fulfilment of the December moon word. Both the announcement and the original telling are checkable.
mentions.falsify_miss: The December telling does not describe a base.

mentions.claim_text: He corrects the wrong picture, says that is the rocket, and that he told Braden to make it next to the rocket because they are going to send one, and they did it and put them in it just like the Lord said.
mentions.quote: I told Braden, I said make it next to the rocket
mentions.falsify_match: The thumbnail choice and the launch both being on record.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a. The claimed hit rests on an image placement decision as much as on a word.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is to bring forth the great revival, that there is a major something and he is looking and can feel it, that they are about to have something major happen, an earthquake, something major about to happen, and mentions this alien thing they are all talking about.
mentions.quote: We're about to have something major happen, an earthquake
mentions.falsify_match: A major earthquake or a disclosure event.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Something major with two candidate forms and no date, so almost any event satisfies it.

mentions.claim_text: He says that if they see the revival this summer and start to see a major event take place, and recalls that when he went and talked to Brother Hagin the Lord allowed him to and Hagin told him the revival will last for two years, repeating it.
mentions.quote: The revival will last for 2 years
mentions.falsify_match: A revival beginning in summer 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: None begins. This gives the two year revival a start window, which the 27 May telling did not have.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are getting really close and that he keeps telling his wife and they keep talking about it in the house, that she asks whether he thinks they will go back past 2030, and that he cannot see past 2028 though he keeps getting glimpses.
mentions.quote: I can't see past 2028. I keep getting glimpses
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an absence of sight rather than a claim about the world, as with the 2028 wall in February.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a
